verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a cloud AI inference platform like Replicate, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency, or data location controls. Docs-7 says Replicate handles the infrastructure, but that does not give the user a region choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
